rationale: The record examines general bureaucratic organizations, employee motivation, and democratic job reform in Western state capitalism and Eastern state socialism. It does not address household or community water or sanitation service access or any water/sanitation access outcomes (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both readings exclude the record under E01 because it is a general sociological discussion of bureaucratic work organization and democratic job reform with no connection to water or sanitation services.
